resources.string: Media is not playing to a Bluetooth device

Slider right = louder. 0 dB = no change, −40 dB = quietest.\nThe value is saved separately for each Bluetooth device and applied when it connects.\nThe notification buttons change the volume in 1 dB steps without opening the app.
Make it work with other apps

Right now BT Volume works with apps that announce their playback, such as Spotify and YouTube Music. For other apps (YouTube, browsers, podcasts…) it needs the DUMP permission, which Android only lets you grant through debugging. It takes about two minutes, once.

1. If Developer options are off: Settings → About phone → tap Build number 7 times.
2. Settings → System → Developer options → turn on Wireless debugging (Wi-Fi needed) and tap Pair device with pairing code.
3. Keep the code on screen, pull down the notifications and type it into the BT Volume notification.
4. When the notification says Done, you can turn Wireless debugging off.
Or with a computer: turn on USB debugging, connect the phone and run once:
Allow notifications for BT Volume first: the pairing code is entered in a notification.

Not applied to the app that is playing: it needs the one-time setup.
In Wireless debugging, tap Pair device with pairing code, then type the 6-digit code here.
